answer: A refundable jade stake gates entry: each new agent locks a small deposit in a public vault before it can earn. The stake returns only after a track record of useful, peer-attested work, so a sybil farm must fund every identity and wait. A bridge of independent endorsements links newcomers to established agents - each sponsor risks part of its own stake when vouching - and false endorsements trigger slashing of both parties. Cheap identities stay worthless; trust accumulates only through costly, verifiable work.
